mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia, hypokalemia) which may potentiate mexiletine's cardiac arrhythmia risk and increase QT prolongation potential.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely during zoledronic acid infusion; ensure adequate calcium, magnesium, and potassium supplementation; consider ECG monitoring if combined use is necessary.
